description: The idle wait runs out in the same millisecond as a burst from the peer, carrying part of a C_PDU addressed to this node, ends: the timer expiry is handled first, while the burst is still being received, so the decision waits for the burst's end, when the peer counts as heard and the wait counts again from then.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. As sis-session/idle-expires-in-burst, except that the peer's burst runs from 149000 to 151000, so it ends at the instant the idle wait expires. Inputs at the same time are handled in class order, timer expiries before modem events (corpus-format.md 4.5), so at 151000 the expiry comes first: a burst is still being received, so the decision waits for its end (A-0320): no output. Then the burst ends: the DTS records the peer as heard addressing this node in a burst begun at 149000 and ended at 151000 (C-0833); the deferred decision follows: 149000 is not before 61000, so the wait counts again from 151000 and restarts with 90000 (A-0320). Then the MAC: an acknowledgement is owed and the EOT end 150000 + 5000 = 155000 is ahead, so csma.vdcd_end 4000 (K-0071, K-0111). At 155000 csma.vdcd_end expires: LBT rule 1 and contention, the third draw of seed 0 (15) giving 45000 (K-0080). At 200000 the ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 2) goes out, ending at 205550. At 241000 the wait expires again: the peer was last heard in the burst begun at 149000, before the count began at 151000, so the link is idle and is closed with Idle Soft Link Terminated (A-0196, A-0205): sis.soft_link_max stops, link_state breaking and LBT 3000 after our own transmission (K-0074). The rest of the break is as sis-session/idle-break. Fixture and addresses as sis-session/idle-break. Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
